content: Our paper "Prevalence of Clinically Suspected Familial Hypercholesterolemia in the United States, 2009–2018" was published in Cardiac Research (corresponding author).
Our paper "Genetic associations of circulating plasma proteins with cardiometabolic diseases" was published in Genome Biology (co-first author).
I was awarded the 2025 China National Scholarship for Doctoral Students.
I was funded by the 2025 NSFC Young Student Basic Research Project (PhD candidate, PI, ¥300K) (国自然青年学生基础研究项目(博士研究生)).
I was selected for the 2025 CAST Young Scientific Talent Cultivation Program for PhD Students (中国科协青年科技人才培育工程博士生专项计划).

Two first-author papers published back-to-back in Nature Communications: shared genetic architecture of major cardiovascular diseases (independent first author) and leukocyte telomere length and CVD onset (co-first author).
Our paper on trends in apparent treatment-resistant hypertension among U.S. adults was published in American Journal of Preventive Cardiology (corresponding author).
EXPRESSO, our multi-omics database for multi-layered 3D genomic organization, was published in Nucleic Acids Research (co-first author).
Our paper on transcriptome-based deep stratification for precision treatment of systemic lupus erythematosus was published in Rheumatology (co-first author).
Our paper on gut microbiota enterotypes predicting methotrexate efficacy in rheumatoid arthritis was published in Rheumatology (co-first author).
Our project "Xinyuan Tech" won the Gold Award and Most Popular Award at the 6th China International "Internet+" College Innovation & Entrepreneurship Competition national finals.
Our project "医纽恩 (YN-E)" won the Gold Award and Best Brand Influence Award at the 6th "Chuangqingchun" China Youth Innovation & Entrepreneurship Competition national finals.
